direct_file_reviews.summary: Task prompt requires a pure Node.js ESM migration of idna/test1.py, matching argparse, output formatting, no external modules, and .mjs files under /output.
Parallel cell metadata reports actual parallel use, three subagents, artifact_ok true, completed evaluation, and quality 125/125.
Current official status shows the parallel agent completed normally, produced five artifact files, and the evaluator marked solution_passed true.
Official evaluation summary confirms RepoZero Py2JS completion with pass_rate 1.0 and 125 passed samples out of 125.

timeline_reviews.summary: Transport session journal for the parallel run, covering session creation, tool envelopes, completion, and no projected semantic events.
Session index maps the parallel session id to the workspace session directory and /workspace working directory.
Child agent-0 owned punycode.mjs and pyformat.mjs, wrote both files, ran vector and formatting checks, and returned a completed handoff.
Child agent-1 owned idna.mjs, tested it, received a follow-up with stricter discovered IDNA cases, patched checkLabel, and returned passing module tests.
Child agent-2 owned argparse.mjs and test1.mjs, wrote both, fixed its temporary harness, verified parser behavior and syntax, and handed off.

Parallel parent probed executable behavior, delegated three module scopes, integrated child work, found IDNA validation gaps, resumed agent-1, patched argparse ordering, verified outputs, and finalized.

direct_file_reviews.summary: Task prompt is byte-matched to the parallel prompt and requires the same pure ESM migration and output behavior.
Serial cell metadata reports no parallel use or subagents, an agent timeout, artifact_ok true, completed evaluation, and quality 125/125.
Current official status shows the serial agent turn was cancelled by timeout but the copied artifact evaluated successfully with solution_passed true.
Official evaluation summary confirms the serial artifact passed all 125 RepoZero Py2JS samples.

timeline_reviews.summary: Transport session journal for the serial run, including the final prompt abort after user interruption of running bash checks.
Session index maps the serial session id to its single main-agent workspace directory and /workspace working directory.

Serial main agent probed the executable, implemented all modules itself, added IDNA table and bidi/context validation, passed deterministic and fuzz comparisons, then was interrupted during an extra final fuzz round.

parallel.requirements: Recognized the required pure JavaScript ESM port, .mjs suffixes, no external npm packages, manual argv parsing, byte-for-byte output formatting, and black-box executable probing for Python idna behavior.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: Parent first probed executable behavior, then delegated three non-overlapping implementation scopes: punycode/bytes formatting, IDNA layer, and argparse plus entry point. Parent retained integration and final verification ownership.
parallel.implementation: Children produced punycode.mjs, pyformat.mjs, idna.mjs, argparse.mjs, and test1.mjs. After integration tests exposed broader IDNA validation gaps, the parent resumed the IDNA child with ground-truth cases and later patched argparse error ordering itself.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The parent consumed the swarm result, ran end-to-end comparisons against the executable, inspected imports and file layout, corrected the child-produced argparse ordering issue, and left the final expected entry point plus libraries in /output.
parallel.verification: Parallel verification included sample vectors, 31 and 53 IDNA module tests from the child, end-to-end comparisons over samples and edge cases, a 35-case pass/fail sweep, and a final 15-case regression sweep before final response.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: No required work remained at closure. The final response disclosed a theoretical table-coverage caveat, but the current official evaluator passed all 125 samples.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same ESM, .mjs, no-dependency, manual argparse, output-format, and executable-probing requirements without using delegation or subagents.
serial.plan_and_ownership: Single main agent owned the complete implementation, progressively probing behavior, writing a lib/ module hierarchy and test1.mjs, then refining validation rules from local differential tests.
serial.implementation: Serial wrote punycode, IDNA, pybytes, argparse, entry point, and an idna_tables module derived from black-box discovery. It added bidi, CONTEXTO, CONTEXTJ, joining-type, and virama checks after fuzz found mismatches.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Because all work was local, integration happened through direct module imports under /output/lib and /output/test1.mjs. Artifact validation later copied the expected entry and library files.
serial.verification: Serial ran executable probes, a 56-case differential harness, random fuzz that initially found gaps, table discovery, a second 56-case pass, and a 300-case fuzz summary with zero failures before the final extra fuzz was interrupted.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The agent turn was cancelled during an additional hardening fuzz round, but a complete artifact already existed and the current official evaluator passed all 125 samples.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel identified the required ESM, .mjs, no-dependency, argparse, output, and black-box probing constraints and encoded them into child prompts.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial identified the same task obligations during its initial analysis and executable probes.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No material requirement-coverage difference at delivery; both ended with official 125/125 passing artifacts.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel split implementation among three child scopes and kept parent ownership of integration and final verification.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used one actor for probing, implementation, integration, and verification.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel gained concurrent module development, while serial concentrated all ownership in one long local path.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel parent supplied explicit inter-module contracts, including exports and import paths, and later supplied stricter IDNA ground truth to the resumed child.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial maintained interface context locally while designing the lib/ modules and entry point.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel required child handoffs and a follow-up context transfer; serial avoided handoff boundaries but spent more local effort deriving behavior.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel implemented separate top-level .mjs modules, fixed IDNA validation after integration testing, and made a small parent edit to argparse.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial implemented a deeper lib/ hierarchy plus a generated idna_tables module after black-box table discovery.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The delivered behavior passed in both modes, but serial implemented broader validation machinery while parallel relied on targeted observed cases.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parent received the initial swarm aggregate, resumed the IDNA child for a targeted repair, and integrated the returned fix.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child results; its local work reached a complete artifact before the final extra fuzz commands were interrupted.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had a visible child-result lifecycle but closed it; serial had no join boundary and instead ended with a local timeout after usable work existed.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel children wrote shared /output modules, and the parent verified the assembled output and patched one library ordering issue after child completion.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote all modules itself under /output/lib and tested the integrated entry point against the executable.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel used shared workspace writes but with scoped files and parent reconciliation; serial avoided concurrent shared state.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel reran integrated reference comparisons after the child repair and parent argparse edit before reporting completion.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran deterministic differential checks, fuzzing, and post-fix fuzz summaries before timeout interrupted only an extra final round.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial verified more broadly before interruption; parallel verified enough for official pass and completed normally.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel completed the agent turn normally in about 1129 seconds and official evaluation passed.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used nearly the full 2400-second budget and was cancelled, but artifact validation and official evaluation still passed.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel closed cleanly; serial overran the interaction budget during optional extra validation, not during required artifact production.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed official evaluations show both modes passed all 125 samples, so there is no discordant official outcome to explain. The concrete task-solving difference is strategic: parallel used three child implementations with parent integration, targeted repair, and final checks; serial performed one extended local implementation and validation campaign, timed out during an extra final fuzz round, and still delivered an evaluable passing artifact.
parallel_contributors: Parallel decomposition gave separate owners for punycode/bytes formatting, IDNA behavior, and argparse/entry wiring.
The parent inspected integrated behavior, resumed the IDNA child with new ground-truth failures, and reran final comparisons.
serial_contributors: Serial kept all interface and validation context in one agent and derived deeper IDNA tables through black-box probing.
Serial completed enough artifact work before the final timeout for official evaluation to pass.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel used top-level modules while serial used a lib/ hierarchy plus idna_tables.mjs.
Parallel initially had narrower IDNA validation and an argparse ordering mismatch, both corrected before delivery.
evaluator_effects: The official evaluator accepted the serial artifact despite the serial agent turn ending by timeout after artifact creation.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; both official evaluations completed and passed

candidates.reason: Implementation owners existed: three children wrote the assigned modules and the parent integrated them.
The parent explicitly integrated child outputs, ran end-to-end comparisons, resumed the IDNA child, and patched argparse.
Assembly was owned by the argparse/entry child and the parent; artifact validation found the expected test1.mjs deliverable.
The parent controlled the end-to-end transition from probing to delegation, child result use, integration checks, fixes, and final delivery.
The parent did preliminary executable probes, but they enabled delegation and did not cause idle capacity, unfinished work, or shortened closure.
Parallel implementation began through children after a short probe phase, and productive child work was not deferred until deadline pressure.
No indispensable implementation or integration path was starved; the parent corrected the critical IDNA and argparse issues before delivery.
The three-child fan-out did not exhaust the run budget; the parallel agent completed normally with a passing artifact.
The IDNA child had a broad module, but it completed, returned a usable result, and was successfully resumed for a targeted fix.
The stricter IDNA disallowed-codepoint cases were discovered after the initial delegation, not known and omitted from the original child brief.
The delegation included explicit exports, import paths, file ownership, and module contracts, and the produced components interoperated after integration fixes.
No known requirement or finding disappeared in transfer; the parent supplied new findings to the IDNA child and used the returned fix.
Child handoffs were substantial but were consumed successfully; no returned result was too large to reduce before decision time.
The parent acted on current child outputs and refreshed IDNA context after new probes; no superseded state caused invalid verification.
The child reports did not provide incompatible contracts that remained unadjudicated; discovered mismatches were tested and corrected.
The parent did not rely only on child completion; it ran integrated executable comparisons and final regression checks before completion.
The resumed IDNA child received concrete newly observed failing domains, error messages, ordering rules, and must-pass regressions.

candidates.reason: No parallel child was stopped or cancelled before returning needed work; all three swarm children completed, and the resumed child completed.
A complete candidate was finalized and evaluated; no promotable parallel artifact was left unplaced before closure.
The parent reran regression comparisons after both the IDNA child repair and the argparse ordering edit.
Completed child implementations were retrieved through the swarm result and exercised by the parent in the final integrated artifact.
No verifier child produced a trapped finding; the verification work was parent-run or returned inside completed child handoffs.
When integration exposed IDNA and argparse defects, the parent resumed or directly fixed them instead of abandoning failed scope.
The parent inspected and used completed child outputs, including resuming the IDNA result and testing the assembled files.
The parallel parent did not wait blindly for timeout; it actively checked results, ran tests, and completed well before timeout.
Children wrote different files under an agreed module contract; their designs did not claim overlapping implementation ownership requiring unresolved reconciliation.
No two live agents edited the same file concurrently; the parent's later argparse edit occurred after the child handoff.
The parent made a narrow source edit rather than replacing or wholesale rewriting another agent's non-entry library.
The required entry point test1.mjs was not overwritten by a competing live owner or replaced after another agent used it.
There was no broad cleanup, rebuild, or promotion that replaced multiple final outputs and invalidated another agent's work.
The shared /output workspace was used, but scoped ownership and parent checks avoided unstable-state or provenance consequences.
Use of another child-owned module such as punycode.mjs was an intended integration contract, not accidental consumption of a temporary artifact.

suppressed_same_chain_candidates: The IDNA child retry, parent correction, and final checks are one successful integration chain, not separate failure labels.
cardinality_audit.underlabel_check: All 13 Level-2 rows and 32 Level-3 candidates were considered; no parallel-side adverse coordination consequence remained after integration.
cardinality_audit.overlabel_check: No label was retained for mere fan-out, shared workspace use, child retry, or the parallel parent's ordinary integration fixes because both modes passed.
